summary: Execute one guarded Provider to Imported to Local parameter dependency chain

args.name: request-file
args.description: JSON request containing complete Provider, Consumer Imported, Local, and Dependency definitions

args.name: --json
args.description: Emit the protocolVersion=1 JSON response envelope

preconditions: ASCET ToolAPI session must be available.
Live ASCET access must run through the serial executor.
The request must contain exact Provider and Consumer component paths.

examples.description: Execute one complete guarded dependency chain

pitfalls: This operation uses compensating rollback rather than a database-native transaction.
Do not retry after mutationStarted=true without first reading the live state.
